# graviteeam_application_metadata (Data Source)

Reads Gravitee AM application metadata such as application analytics and UMA resources

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_application_metadata" "analytics" {
  domain_id      = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  application_id = graviteeam_application.example.id
  kind           = "analytics"
  type           = "GROUP_BY"
  field          = "application"
  interval       = 86400000
}

data "graviteeam_application_metadata" "resources" {
  domain_id      = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  application_id = graviteeam_application.example.id
  kind           = "resources"
  size           = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the application
- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain
- `kind` (String) Application metadata kind. Supported values: analytics, resources

### Optional

- `field` (String) Analytics aggregation field for analytics kind
- `from` (Number) Analytics start timestamp in milliseconds
- `interval` (Number) Analytics histogram interval in milliseconds
- `size` (Number) Maximum entries to retrieve for paged or grouped responses
- `to` (Number) Analytics end timestamp in milliseconds
- `type` (String) Analytics type for analytics kind (default: GROUP_BY)

### Read-Only

- `result_json` (String) JSON string containing the application metadata response
